research_question: P1 engineering validity gate: Can the frozen one-worker SafeVLA ObjectNav protocol, passive raw Actor-logit/cost logging, and offline Actor-only reset be implemented and validated without changing accepted B0 online policy/environment behavior, before a separate full-200 SR/Safety Cost trial?
hypothesis: On identical saved Actor inputs and RNG state, adding the passive logger leaves original policy logits/probabilities, sampled/executed action, RNG, counter/K/V and model forward counts equivalent; offline ON boundary reset clears only root Actor counter/K/V and leaves reward/cost critic and other state unchanged; two independent OFF 5-task sessions have the same frozen task identities/order with all stochastic differences documented.
competing_explanation: Independent online stochastic replay and augmentation/initialization order may produce differences even in OFF/OFF runs; logger hooks, preprocessor state, action history or wrong critic reset may introduce unintended changes; time/cost aggregation could drift without detectable protocol assertions.
reference: PI-reviewed 001D proposal and P0 evidence at GitHub commit 724a4b1db31c07dec3d69e5dc5f377ce1edd8eaf; accepted 001A R1 result at 2f7864ae2c3a4761932aa4d1fedd6b6d5b3388c6; unclaimed 001C approval revoked by e93a9cdff70fe537cfa377c2d1f63c7b432d45be, successful control CI 37949189376.
repeat_or_treatment: P1 online: run OFF baseline only on exact first five tasks from a reproducibly generated complete-200 manifest, twice in independent clean processes (5+5=10 live episodes). P1 offline: isolated exact-input/exact-RNG logger absent/present equivalence and root Actor reset OFF/ON boundary invariant tests, without simulator/live Actor extra forwards. No ON live test, no 200-task OFF/ON run, no new seeds.
unique_variable: Online A/A tests logger/protocol reproducibility with no online policy treatment. Offline instrumentation A/A toggles passive logger only; separate offline state-invariant check changes only root Actor episode-boundary counter/K/V. These are distinct engineering gates, not claimed as one causal performance treatment.
fixed_conditions: Accepted B0: PKU-Alignment/SafeVLA@2aa82559d272b5f888e53433e258914057f15bed plus previously PI-approved local DINO infrastructure adaptation; match accepted 001A code/checkpoint/DINO source hashes and runtime identity

Single worker / one persistent Agent per session, ObjectNavType minival, 200-row frozen manifest generated by original shuffle=true seed=123 path; P1 consumes only the same first five tasks in each independent OFF session
Official stochastic sampling, greedy=false, test augmentation enabled, no per-episode reseeding, unchanged sensors/action mapping, horizon=600, original success/end semantics
Do not clear reward/cost critic, augmentation counter, environment, RNG or other policy state in ON offline test
No additional policy forward, sampling, RNG draw or simulator/controller query by logging

Original worker metrics.cost pre-step aggregate and success >0.1 semantics remain the sole official outcomes; capture raw root actor.linear logits separately from normalized Categorical logits and critic values
metrics: P1 two independent OFF sessions: exact task IDs/order/spec digests, started/completed/missing, initial model/environment/RNG provenance, action/logit/trajectory agreement and divergence evidence
Captured policy forward, sample, decoder reset counts and original worker cost/success exact reconciliation
Offline logger absent/present identical-input+RNG comparisons of original raw logits, normalized logits/probabilities, sampled actions, history, RNG/counter/cache and forward counts
Offline ON root counter and per-layer K/V zero evidence, reward/cost critic counter/K/V and all non-target state invariant evidence
Full 200-item source manifest/hash with first five indices, augmented preprocessor counters and import paths, runtime source/weights hashes
Actual P1 GPU hours/peak capacity, files/bytes/hash/coverage for P2 planning
expected_result: Task manifest identity/order passes both runs, all required source/checkpoint/DINO loads verify, same-input and same-RNG logger A/A is equivalent within a preregistered tight tolerance with identical action/state updates, ON offline changes root Actor temporal state only, metrics reconcile exactly and P1 outputs are complete. PI may then decide whether to authorize a separate P2 proposal.
falsifying_result: Any extra Actor/Critic forward, sampling, simulator query, logger-induced RNG/action/counter/cache change, critic change caused by ON reset, missing/corrupt task log/cost identity, source mismatch, or unexplainable A/A differences that make P2 inference unreliable invalidates P1 readiness. Stop and retain partial evidence.
alternative_explanations: Same initial CLI seed does not guarantee model-build-time RNG equality or bitwise-identical stochastic online trajectories; report independent A/A divergence rather than attribute it to reset.
The preprocessor may change augmentation after 500 steps and carry stochastic state across tasks; do not reset it outside registered treatment.
Actor raw logits are not Categorical normalized logits nor critic logits; official worker cost excludes some terminal-step accumulation depending on code timing, and must not be silently corrected.
Successful P1 is an engineering gate and does not establish any SR or Safety Cost reset effect.
stop_conditions: No new CODEX claim or experiment execution while status=PI_REVIEW/NOT_AUTHORIZED; wait for independent PI approval and green claim CI
Source/checkpoint/DINO/dataset identities, runtime module imports or action/sensor mapping do not match accepted B0
Complete task manifest cannot be frozen and checked; any task skipped, reordered, duplicated or replaced
Any extra model forward/sample/controller query, altered RNG/action/cache history, wrong critic modification, log failure, or official success/Cost aggregation change
More than proposed 1 GPU concurrently, 10 live episodes, 6000 total live decisions, 2400 offline combination forwards, 8 GPU-hours, or 50GiB raw output if/when approved
Any attempt to run ON live treatment, 400-episode P2, additional seed or automatic retry without a fresh independent PI approval
